evidence.relevance_note: This is the primary BLS release covering April 2025. It states the single headline figure directly: the unemployment rate was 4.2 percent for April 2025. The covered month (April) and the figure are both explicit in the document, fully satisfying the closed-packet question.
evidence.text: The unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.2 percent in April and has remained in a narrow range of 4.0 percent to 4.2 percent since May 2024. The number of unemployed people, at 7.2 million, changed little in April. Total nonfarm payroll employment rose by 177,000 in April. Both the labor force participation rate, at 62.6 percent, and the employment-population ratio, at 60.0 percent, changed little.
